besluite.fout: 'Deur 'n mikroskoop ... uitken' copies English 'through a microscope'; the fixed Afrikaans expression is 'onder 'n mikroskoop', as the lesson's own title uses.
besluite.rede: Same meaning in both (Koch used a microscope to recognise the germ), and the proposal is the natural idiom; no protected wording is touched.
The original word order already reads well and the proposal only moves an adverbial without making the sentence easier, so it is a lateral move.
